from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialMetric(BaseModel):
    """A single financial metric entry from one company's financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company the report belongs to")
    company_code: str | None = Field(description="Security code if available")
    metric_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the financial metric (e.g., 交易性金融资产)")
    metric_value: float | None = Field(description="The reported value for this metric")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit (e.g., 元)")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period (e.g., 2024年第一季度)")
    statement_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of financial statement, e.g., 合并资产负债表")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_metrics: list[FinancialMetric]
